title: Automations with a fixed time don't always start reliably
symptom: Automations with a fixed time (e.g., at 20:00) sometimes do not start reliably. The user observes that the background automation queries occur at very irregular intervals, sometimes with gaps of several minutes, causing the fixed-time automation to be missed. This happens about once a week across different AAPS and Android versions.
cause: The user suspects that the irregular query interval for background automations causes fixed-time automations to be missed when the query interval is longer than the tolerance around the scheduled time. The maintainer states that background automation requires Loop enabled and in OPEN/CLOSE/LGS mode, pump connected, and Objective 10 started, but the user confirms these are met.
evidence_quote: The 8:00 PM query exceeded a tolerance, and the start was discarded.
